At the Vancouver Web Summit, I participated in a panel with @ryangrim and Stephen Walt to discuss the Iran War and the wavering of U.S. hegemonic power in the region. 

Watch now: piped.video/watch?v=2d2mOsUk…

A commenter recently asked me if the economic havoc wreaked by Iran's closing of the Strait of Hormuz will push the U.S. to adopt renewable energy. With the Trump administration, the entire existence of the climate crisis is not even acknowledged. Conversations—much less the concrete pursuit of logical political objectives—cannot be accomplished in such states of magical thinking.

Video

In his new book, “Palaces of the Crow,” Ray Nayler examines human nature through the lens of caring and community amidst the often hidden horrors of World War II. Watch us discuss the novel on the latest episode of The Chris Hedges Report.

Link: piped.video/watch?v=hjZ35_Ri…

Richard Wolff acknowledges that we are an empire in decline. But what is worse, he warns, is that our leaders are in denial of that decline.

Video

Ramzy Baroud explains the history of Palestinian revolutionary movements, and breaks down how Hamas is, more than an 'Islamist' organization, a national liberation movement — one that combats apartheid and has shifted its rhetoric to appeal to a global audience. piped.video/watch?v=knchHmXg…

Ramzy Baroud explains how much of Palestinian history is often seen through the lens of the Palestinian elite, partially as a reaction to the Western audience which Palestinian stories attempt to appeal to. What this ignores is the history of the Palestinian peasantry, and their noble revolutionary spirit that has driven change throughout history. 
piped.video/watch?v=opnpnWCA…

Trump is a cult leader — one that will not be easily replaced. But that doesn't mean that the GOP will lose power once he is gone. There is the very real consideration that, in order to cling to the power Trump cultivated for them, we will see a much more nakedly fascist system take his place.

Video

A commenter recently asked me how we build a new left in the face of increasing fascist repression within the U.S. and abroad. I answered that this new movement, were it to form, would need to be characterized by two guiding principles — anti-capitalism and and anti-imperialism.

Video

This article was originally published at my Substack. To continue my independent journalism, I depend on the generosity and support of my readers. If you'd like to support me directly, you can do so at my Substack: chrishedges.substack.com Thank you for all your support.

Professor Ramzy Baroud chronicles the powerful resistance to Zionism and its manifestations in the current national liberation movement on the latest episode of The Chris Hedges Report. Hamas is, above all else he says, a national liberation movement. Watch now.

Link: piped.video/watch?v=gSAwYW2s…

America’s suicidal march began long before Donald Trump. Trump and the buffoons around him are the inevitable final chapter of the decaying empire. 

Watch Eunice Wong's reading of my column, "America's Suicide Pact", now:
piped.video/watch?v=pVQqv8FV…

This article was originally published at my Substack. To continue my independent journalism, I depend on the generosity and support of my readers. If you'd like to support me directly, you can do so at my Substack: chrishedges.substack.com Thank you for all your support.

A commenter on a livestream recently asked me if my faith has ever wavered through the multiple war zones I've reported in, and now the genocide in Gaza that we have all witnessed. I described how the evil in all of us is indeed real, but so is the good.

Video

Through the genocide in Gaza and the Iran war, Israel has shown how AI has been completely subsumed into the economy of war. AI companies will work with anyone — and their collaboration with the imperialist powers of the world looks set to expand.

Video

Globalization created long supply chains that span  entire seas. Their length and complexity made them vulnerable to major disruption — something Iran is making clear in the Strait of Hormuz. Watch Richard Wolff's breakdown: piped.video/watch?v=dWMkTFR6…
